$comment: Canonical parameters for the ground vehicle model files. Source column: project = read from the Java model/geometry sources; blender = exported from blender_m1a5 via tools/generate_ground_unit_model.py; reference = measured from docs/plan/ground-units-reference-images.md R1; assumption = chosen for the export and flagged as inferred.

units.export_unit: 1 model unit; block and metre columns are derived
units.metre_conversion: 1 block = 1 m (assumption for the metric column only)
units.axes: Y up, nose along -Z, +X is the vehicle's right (same as the Java renderer)

hull_length_units.evidence: real M1A2 hull 7.93 m x 16; tools/data/m1a5_boxes.json

hull_top_units.evidence: Blender hull roof z 1.52 m x 16 (revision 2, lowered per feedback)

turret_pivot_height_units.evidence: turret ring on the hull roof; matches MainBattleTankGeometry

barrel_length_units.evidence: muzzle at y -5.805 m from the hull centre x 16

missile_tubes.evidence: R3 shows a quad launcher box; tube count inferred

known_deviation.tank_real_scale: The tank model was replaced by the Blender-derived box set on 2026-09-14: 9.77 m gun-forward, 3.66 m wide, 2.44 m to the turret roof - the real M1A2 dimensions the mod now uses (MainBattleTankGeometry). The STL lifts rotated armour plates to their axis-aligned bounds, so glacis and turret-top slopes are slightly conservative.
known_deviation.ifv_reference_ratio: IFV bbox still matches its Java geometry; see docs/plan/ground-units-model-log.md for the earlier ratio notes.
